The Chinese characters for Edward

As a transliteration, Edward is usually written 爱德华 (Ài dé huá). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

爱
Ài
love
德
dé
virtue, morality
华
huá
splendid, China

Origin and meaning

From English, Edward carries the meaning “wealthy guard”.

About the name Edward

Carried by eight English kings, including Edward the Confessor.

As a gift or a tattoo

If you are choosing a name for a print or a tattoo, Edward carries the meaning “wealthy guard” and looks striking in brush strokes.
